problem_derivation: The quoted FW5 line 601 requires an active route: a connected subnetwork of actual occurrences joining the named represented input to the named operative result, satisfying the component relations and role bindings, with a nonconstant dependence on the relevant represented distinction under declared contrasts; dead branches, cancelled signals with no downstream role, and carrier details that change while the represented reason does not cannot supply that dependence; collective blocks remain available. Mapped to the later task: the objection's content C must stand in a traceable relation to the published response P and the downstream result R of request B. Under U as stated, use requires (1) a response-operative public mapping from C to a dependency set D, (2) D active in the trace deriving R from B, (3) contrast variation of D changing the downstream allocation role, (4) no dead branch or carrier detail, and (5) missing contrast or mapping leaving use unsettled. In the kiln case, K1 pre-exists in P0, P1 does not introduce or modify D because of C and records no retention/selection decision, so condition (1) fails even though K1 is semantically bound to C, active, and contrast-changing. The answer is therefore NO; note also that the opposite reading is what the weaker relation would give, which is why the response-operative clause was added.
